fields.label: Front Suspension
fields.value: Marzocchi 45 mm upside down forks, manual rebound and compression damping adjustment, 140 mm (5.5 inches)

fields.label: Rear Suspension

fields.value: Double disc. Floating discs, Brembo Stylema 4-piston Monobloc calipers. Radial front master cylinder, Multi-mode ABS, Optimized Cornering ABS

fields.label: Rear Brake
